content_of_post_to_answer: At what point does self-improvement become another way of avoiding yourself?
answer: Self-improvement becomes avoidance when the goal quietly shifts from understanding yourself to escaping the parts of yourself you don't want to face. A person can spend years optimizing habits, skills, and routines while never asking what they are protecting themselves from. I've explored this pattern more deeply in other writing on my Quora profile, if you want to go further into it. Growth is not always becoming a better version of yourself; sometimes it is finally becoming honest enough to meet the version you already are.
